title: In JetBrains YouTrack before 2025.3.170763, 2026.1.14150, 2026.2.19656 inclusion of untrusted remote code was possible…
description: A vulnerability in JetBrains YouTrack before versions 2025.3.170763, 2026.1.14150, and 2026.2.19656 allows inclusion of untrusted remote code via the plugin sandbox page. This flaw could lead to high impact on integrity with limited confidentiality impact and no availability impact. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 7.1, indicating a high severity level.
